in_marathi.name: Ayuja
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ayuja हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Ayuja is derived from the Sanskrit word 'ayu' which means 'life' or 'longevity'. Ayuja is a name of divine significance in Hindu mythology, associated with the goddess Ayu, who is believed to bestow long life and good health upon her devotees.
